E1116

`Shared.{method}(…)` is the retired closure form for shared access.

What

`Shared.{method}(…)` is the retired closure form for shared access.

Why

D-CONC-SHARE1=A made a shared value read and write like a value: a field read is one locked read, a field write is one locked write, and each statement is one atomic step. The closure per touch proved nothing the compiler did not already know.

Fix

Read the field directly (`config.name`) and write it directly (`config.hits += 1`); group several steps under `#Transact {{ … }}`, or take an expert guard with `.guard_edit()`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1116: tests/ui/shared_retired_closure_access.stderr.

Error [E1116]: `Shared.read(…)` is the retired closure form for shared access.

    |                  ^^^^

 Fix: read the field directly (`config.name`) and write it directly (`config.hits += 1`); group several steps under `#Transact { … }`, or take an expert guard with `.guard_edit()`.
